title: Jonah and the Static
author: Felix Nakamura
blurb: Mirabel Reyes, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
